snippet.title: Tyro: Legend of Whisperwood - Official Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
➤ WISHLIST ON STEAM - https://wishlist.tryogame.com

The Alpha Demo launches June 13, 2025!

Dive into the first glimpse of Tyro: Legend of Whisperwood, an emotional 2D adventure where a brave young mouse battles to save his home from the spreading corruption known as the Gladeblight.

In this Alpha Demo, you'll:

* Explore the ruins of Beetle City
* Unlock new abilities like the slingshot, dash, and heal
* Solve environmental puzzles
* Face a challenging boss + unlockable secret boss 

This is just the beginning of Tyro's journey.

➤ Learn more at https://turtlevaniagames.com/go/yt
➤ Join the community and follow our updates!

#IndieGame #Metroidvania #GameDev #TyroLegendOfWhisperwood
